auth_details: API key as apiKey URL query param (GET) or JSON body property (POST); self-serve signup on eventregistry.org / newsapi.ai. Header auth not documented.
free_tier_limits: 2,000 free tokens/searches total for testing (one-time, not renewed monthly); free tier limited to last 30 days of content; token cost varies by endpoint/result size
rate_limits: Maximum 5 simultaneous requests per user; excess concurrent requests return HTTP 429
resolution_notes: auth.details: auditor right—docs require apiKey as URL param (e.g. apiKey=YOUR_API_KEY), not header; POST examples put apiKey in JSON body (https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=introduction). free_tier_limits: auditor right—Free is one-time 2,000 tokens for testing, not monthly; last-30-days data only (https://newsapi.ai/plans; docs intro). paid_plans: auditor right—null was wrong; populate from https://newsapi.ai/plans (5K–500K + custom). rate_limits: auditor right—max 5 simultaneous → 429 (docs Rate Limiting).
